title: Praise Him! Praise Him!
lyrics: [G]Praise Him! praise Him! [C]Jesus, our blessed Re-[G]deemer!
Sing, O [Em]Earth, His [A7]wonderful love pro-[D]claim!
[G]Hail Him! hail Him! [C]highest archangels in [G]glory;
Strength [G7]and [C]honor [G]give to His [D7]holy [G]Name!
[D]Like [G]a [D]shepherd, [D7]Jesus will guard His [G]chil-[D7]dren,
[G]In His [Em]arms He [A7]carries them all day [D]long:
[G]Praise Him! Praise Him! [C]Tell of His excellent [G]greatness.
Praise [G7]Him! [C]Praise Him! [G]Ever in [D7]joyful [G]song!
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
For our sins He suffered, and bled, and died.
He our Rock, our hope of eternal salvation,
Hail Him! hail Him! Jesus the Crucified.
Sound His praises! Jesus who bore our sorrows,
Love unbounded, wonderful, deep and strong.
Praise Him! Praise Him! Jesus, our blessed Redeemer!
Heavenly portals loud with hosannas ring!
Jesus, Savior, reigneth forever and ever.
Crown Him! Crown Him! Prophet, and Priest, and King!
Christ is coming! over the world victorious,
Power and glory unto the Lord belong.
